Scheduler Studio

A planning interface for coordinating academic, work, and project commitments with conflict-aware scheduling.

Overview

Scheduler Studio focused on making dense scheduling information easier to understand and act on.

I worked on the interaction model and visual hierarchy for the planner so users could see commitments, conflicts, and available capacity at a glance.

Technical Work

The frontend was built around reusable calendar and detail components, supported by a straightforward backend for persistence and scheduling rules.

This is a good example of balancing technical implementation with usability and maintainability.
